CUNAMH IVERAGH greatly appreciates your continued support for our Respite home for adults with intellectual Disabilities in Cahirciveen. As we approach the Christmas festive season, we wish to take a moment to express our sincere appreciation and gratitude to all our local businesses, from Dromid to Waterville. We are truly blessed to have such a wonderful variety of businesses and services within our parish, catering for the needs of parishioners and visitors alike. Behind every business are local people, families and livelihoods that play such an important part in keeping our community alive and thriving. We encourage everyone, wherever possible, to support local. Every purchase, no matter how small, makes a difference. By supporting our local businesses, we are also supporting local families, creating employment and helping to sustain the vibrant community we are so fortunate to call home. Loving God, we ask your blessing upon all our local businesses. May you guide and strengthen those who work tirelessly to serve our community. Bless their homes, their families and their livelihoods. May their work bring them fulfilment and security, and may our community continue to support one another with generosity and kindness. Amen.
